title: Rules file (data/rules/<id>.json, one set of rules per file)
description: The numbers a system runs on, so tuning needs no code (GDD §6). The file's id says which rules it holds. Known ids: 'time' (the day's clock, read by DayClock), 'energy' (the hero's energy, read by EnergyRules), 'hours' (when places are open and villagers are out, read by Hours), 'night' (what the night does to monsters, read by NightRules), 'farm' (the hero's plot, read by Farm), 'skills' (the hero's skills, read by Skills) and 'friendship' (what talk and gifts are worth, read by Friendship).

day_ends.description: When the day runs out. A time before day_starts is in the small hours of the next morning.

seconds_per_hour.description: Real seconds one hour of the day takes.

lamps_lit.description: When lamps are lit. May run over midnight.

night.description: When it is night. May run over midnight.

light.description: The colour of the light outdoors at times of the day, in order from the day's start to its end. Between two times the light is between their colours.

color.description: Red, green and blue, each 0 to 1. Everything outdoors is multiplied by it: [1, 1, 1] is clear daylight.

costs.description: What things cost. Anything not named here is free.

hoe.description: Tilling a cell of the plot with the hoe.

water.description: Watering a cell of the plot with the can.

below.description: Under this energy the hero is tired.

move.description: The share of his speed he keeps when tired.

cooldown.description: What the sword's cooldown is multiplied by when tired.

no_sprint_below.description: Under this energy he can't sprint.

collapse.description: What running out of energy (or staying up until the day ends) costs.

wake_share.description: The share of a full bar he wakes with.

coins_lost_share.description: The share of his coins he loses, rounded down.

coins_lost_most.description: The most coins he can lose.

places.description: A place's id (an AreaExit's `hours`), then when its door is open. May run over midnight.

shut.description: What is said at the door when it is shut.

outdoors.description: When villagers who stand outdoors are out; the rest of the day they have gone home.

then.description: What a monster met outdoors at night (the 'night' span of the time rules) is multiplied by. 1 leaves it as by day.

coin_drops.description: The weight of each coin drop in its table.

plot.description: The size of the hero's plot in cells. Where it lies is the FarmPlot node's position in its area.

wither_after.description: How many dry mornings in a row wither a crop.

levels.description: The points each level begins at, rising, the first of them 0.

step.description: The share each level above the first takes off a cost a skill eases, or adds to a dish. Times the levels above the first it must stay under 1.

skills.description: The hero's skills by id, in the order the pause menu lists them.

gains.description: The points each deed gives. The game reports: monster, boss, till, harvest, dish.

eases.description: The energy costs (the energy rules' names) each level makes cheaper.

enriches_dishes.description: Each level makes a cooked dish give more energy.

marks.description: How many marks a full friendship is.

points_per_mark.description: The points that make one mark.

talk.description: The points for the first talk with a villager in a day.

liked_gift.description: The points for a gift the villager likes. At least other_gift.

other_gift.description: The points for any other gift.

gift_types.description: The item types that can be given (types that items in data/items have).

$comment: One entry of allOf for each id: time, energy, hours, night, farm, skills, friendship.

time_of_day.description: A time on a 24-hour clock, like "06:00".
